import json,sys,csv,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root));local=Path(__file__).parent
from ground_truth_studio.integrity_service import sha256
from ground_truth_studio.bbox_snapshot import committed_reviews
from ground_truth_studio.bbox_export_adapter import export_approvals
from ground_truth_studio.bbox_service import load_queue
from ground_truth_studio.config import Settings
from src.scene_subset import build_subset
out=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/scene_20261115_72a6d1eb';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def save(name,value):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
parent=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/recovery_20261115_e733a6c3'
proofdir=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/finalize_20261115_9f8bacb3/lineage'
private=Settings.load().private
reviews=committed_reviews(local/'snapshot',original_private=private)
previous=json.loads((root/'.tools/week5_recovery_e733a6c3/snapshot/snapshot_receipt.json').read_text())
assert all(sha256(private/p)==h for p,h in previous['checksums'].items() if not p.endswith('.sqlite3'))
queue={r['image_sha256']:r for r in load_queue(root)}
export=export_approvals(root,reviews,queue,local/'approved_export',lineage_dir=proofdir,version_root=local/'snapshot/bbox_qa/versions')
latest={r['image_sha256']:r for r in reviews};candidates=[]
mapping={'TRAIN_CANDIDATE':'train','TRAIN_LEGACY_RESERVATION':'train','VALIDATION_CANDIDATE':'val','VAL_LEGACY_RESERVATION':'val'}
for key,row in queue.items():
 path=proofdir/(key+'.json');proof=json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
 candidates.append(dict(row,split=mapping.get(row['reserved_split'],'test_or_blocked'),
   human_approved=latest.get(key,{}).get('decision')=='APPROVE',
   lineage_verified=proof.get('status') in ['VERIFIED_NATIVE_DECODE','VERIFIED_DERIVED_IMAGE'],
   source_video_sha256=proof.get('source_video_sha256')))
quarantine=json.loads((parent/'source_quarantine.json').read_text())
subset=build_subset(candidates,set(),{quarantine['source_sha256']});save('clean_vn_manifest.json',subset)
counts=Counter(r['source_video_sha256'] for r in candidates if r['human_approved'] and r['lineage_verified'])
shortlist=[{'source_pair':p,'approved_verified_impact':sum(counts[s] for s in p),
 'decision':'UNRESOLVED','needed':'Source/camera/visual scene evidence, reviewer/time, member hash bindings',
 'test_reserved':True} for p in subset['unresolved_source_pairs']]
shortlist.sort(key=lambda r:(-r['approved_verified_impact'],r['source_pair']))
save('human_source_shortlist.json',shortlist)
scene=json.loads((parent/'human_scene_decision_queue.json').read_text())
observation=json.loads((parent/'scene_resolution.json').read_text())['prior_visual_findings']['observations'][0]
for sheet in observation['evidence']:assert sha256(root/sheet['path'])==sheet['sha256']
group=next(g for g in scene['DFIRE'] if g['group_id']==observation['group_id'])
group.update(decision='CONFIRMED_OVERLAP_SAME_CAMERA_SCENE',evidence=observation,
 decision_origin='Prior technical visual observation with verified contact-sheet SHA; not bbox approval')
save('scene_group_manifest.json',scene)
save('scene_summary.json',{'VN_candidate_pairs':75,'VN_resolved':0,'VN_unresolved':75,
 'DFIRE_candidate_groups':751,'DFIRE_confirmed_overlap':1,'DFIRE_confirmed_independent':0,'DFIRE_unresolved':750,
 'cross_source_independence_shortlist':len(shortlist),'no_test_to_train':True,
 'parent_scene_sha256':sha256(parent/'human_scene_decision_queue.json')})
save('approval_snapshot.json',{'versions':len(reviews),'approved':export['human_approved_count'],'pending':export['pending_count'],
 'rejected':export['rejected_count'],'delta_from_922':export['human_approved_count']-922,
 'negative':sum(r.get('negative_frame_approved',False) for r in export['approved_bbox_reviews']),
 'positive_bbox':sum(bool(r['boxes']) for r in export['approved_bbox_reviews']),
 'exclusion_statuses':dict(Counter(r['status'] for r in export['excluded_rows'])),
 'prior_versions_unchanged':True,'sqlite_integrity':'ok','eligible_train':subset['train_count'],'eligible_val':subset['val_count']})
for name in ['baseline_membership.json','new_baseline_protocol.json','dataset_manifest.json','clean_dfire_manifest.json','resource_pilot_receipt.json']:
 shutil.copyfile(parent/name,out/name)
save('parent_sha256.json',{p.name:sha256(p) for p in parent.glob('*.json')})
print(json.dumps(json.loads((out/'approval_snapshot.json').read_text())));print(json.dumps(json.loads((out/'scene_summary.json').read_text())))

import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];local=Path(__file__).parent
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',YOLO_AUTOINSTALL='false',PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8')
env['PATH']=str(root/'.tools/ffmpeg')+os.pathsep+env['PATH']
report=root/'docs/multicamera_rtsp_benchmark_report.md';before=report.read_bytes();results=[]
commands=[('targeted',[sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_scene_subset.py','tests/test_decoder_diagnostic.py','tests/test_lineage_run_audit.py','tests/test_week5_readiness.py','tests/test_bbox_qa.py','tests/test_domain_adaptation.py','tests/test_week5_unblock.py']),('full',[sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests'])]
try:
 for name,command in commands:
  log=local/(name+'.log');start=time.perf_counter()
  with log.open('w',encoding='utf-8') as stream:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  results.append({'name':name,'command':command,'exit_code':r.returncode,'duration_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'log':log.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'tail':log.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines()[-2:]})
  (local/'tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(results[-1]),flush=True)
finally:report.write_bytes(before)
sys.exit(0 if all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in results) else 1)
